verdict.rationale: Evidence indirectly confirms scripting exists (references to 'preserve scripts' during Postman import/export, and a feature request asking for fs module access 'in pre-request scripts') but the pack contains no first-party documentation walking through the pre-request/post-response scripting API, chaining requests, or data massaging patterns. The one concrete community data point (bruno-comm-8) shows a real limitation: filesystem modules are not available in pre-request scripts, restricting some data-massaging use cases. missing for 10: dedicated docs on scripting API/examples, evidence of chaining requests via scripts, confirmation that the fs limitation has been resolved.
